dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I'm surprised the Wangshu Inn doesn't get the day off... It's the biggest day of the year...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: My sister works there. It's been years since we last spent Lantern Rite together.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I should raise it with the Ministry of Civil Affairs...
